pages.quiz:
GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only

4. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.

5. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   B. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   C. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   B. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   D. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   C. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   B. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Industry as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   C. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.
   D. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   B. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   D. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   B. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   D. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
